Hi Marloes,

You can reset your password via the login page. Go to app.roosterly.nl/login, click on "Forgot password" and fill in your email address. You will receive a reset link within 10 minutes (also check your spam folder). The link is valid for 60 minutes. Follow the steps in the email to set a new password and then you can log in again.

Team Roosterly
